newsitem.title: USA: Chantal Pharma has agreement with dissident.
newsitem.headline: Chantal Pharma has agreement with dissident.

text.p: Chantal Pharmaceutical Corp said Tuesday it has reached an agreement with most of the dissident stockholders' group that recently filed opposition to its management with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

Twelve members of the group, representing a 4.12 percent stock ownership, issued a statement disassociating themselves from the dissidents and agreeing to support chairman and chief executive Chantal Burnison.
They have also agreed to support all management nominees for the board at the annual meeting scheduled for July 17 in Los Angeles.
The company said the original group included 19 stockholders claiming to own 6.96 percent of its stock.

The 12 stockholders, including Peter Ting and William Gibson, issued a statement that they share the company's concerns regarding dissident stockholder actions, and those concerns have led them to disassociate themselves from the dissidents.
Further, they said they have confidence in the current management based on positive talks with Burnison and others.

The company, which filed a federal court action against the signers of the opposition on June 18 charging misrepresentations and non-compliance with the federal securities laws, has agreed to drop the action against the 12 stockholders who have agreed to support management.
The company said the dissident group now has seven members, owning about 2.84 percent of the stock.
